title: Agent capability profile
description: Declarative description of one agent's skill format support. Everything the converter needs to know about a target agent lives here; adding an agent should not require code unless the agent uses a non-SKILL.md format.

id.description: Stable machine identifier. Used as `--from`/`--to` value and as the profile filename stem.

format.description: `agent-skills` means the agent reads the Agent Skills layout natively and a data-only profile is sufficient. `proprietary` means a custom adapter is required.

verification.description: `verified`: every encoded fact traced to a primary source. `partial`: at least one fact is inferred or only documented by a third party. `unverified`: profile is a placeholder.

fieldAliases.description: Maps a foreign spelling of a field to the spelling this agent uses, so the pipeline can rename instead of dropping. Only needed where agents disagree on capitalisation or separators.

fields.description: Per-frontmatter-field support. Keys are the field names as the target agent spells them. Any field absent from this map must be treated as `unknown` by the converter, which then warns instead of guessing.

extensions.description: Agent-specific behaviours with no equivalent elsewhere. Listed so the report can name what a conversion loses.

path.description: Use `~` for the user home, `<angle-brackets>` for values only known at runtime.

precedence.description: Lower wins. null when the agent does not document an ordering.

skillDirDepth.description: How many directory levels below a root a skill directory may sit and still be found.

acceptsFlatMarkdown.description: Whether a bare `<name>.md` file is loaded as a skill, in addition to `<name>/SKILL.md`.

upwardSearch.description: Whether roots are also scanned in ancestor directories up to the repository root.

nestedLazyLoad.description: Whether skills in directories below the working directory load on demand instead of at startup.

pattern.description: ECMAScript regex the name must match, or null when the agent imposes no character grammar.

enforcement.description: What the agent does when a name violates the rules.

maxLength.description: Hard validation limit, or null when the agent never rejects an over-long description.

configurableBy.description: Config key that changes the bound, if any.

combinesWith.description: Other fields that count toward the same budget.

mapsTo.description: Target field that carries the same meaning, when it is spelled differently.

fieldStatus.description: supported: honoured with equivalent semantics. ignored: accepted but has no effect. emulated: the converter can approximate it through another mechanism. unsupported: no equivalent exists. unknown: not verified.

fidelityImpact.description: Best achievable outcome when this extension is present in the source and the target is another agent.
